__doc__: The canonical ActivityTemplate of each object maker, one per recipe, with a FIXED uuid: an Activity always references the same template whatever the package, and a consumer recognises the operation by uuid. The Creation is fixed for the same reason: the template inserted into two packages is the same object, byte for byte. Adding a maker means adding an entry here with a new uuid, which becomes canonical at its first commit; never change an existing uuid, it would orphan every activity already written.
